name: Terschelling Frisian
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Knop, G. 1954. De spraakkunst der Terschellinger dialecten. Assen: Van Gorcum.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1/5.2 languoid page ters1236 (refs: Markey 1981: 174-175; Heeringa 2005; K.F. van der Veen 2001).
sources.note: Bibliographic pointers only; no descriptive refs classified as grammar/phonology.

sources.citation: Knop, G. 1949. Fersen yn de Schylger tongslach. (poems, 146 pp.)
sources.note: Poetry collection; text a full-text search for stress/accent klemtoon/accent/klam/útspraak: no pronunciation or stress note.

sources.citation: Knop, G. 1938-39. 'De phonologische beschrijving van het Westerschellingsch' [I: vowel phonemes]. Onze Taaltuin 7: 363-377.
sources.note: Trubetzkoyan phoneme inventory of West-Terschelling vowels (quantity correlation, 'scharf/schwach geschnittener Silbenaccent' = syllable cut, diphthongs); no statement on where word stress falls. 'klemtoon' appears once, diachronically: the first element of a rising diphthong 'kon wegvallen, nadat hij den klemtoon had verloren' (p. 372).

sources.citation: Knop, G. 1935-36. 'Schylgerlaner Leisboek'; Knop, G. 1936-37. 'Uit den Schellinger taaltuin' (2 instalments). Onze Taaltuin 4 and 5.
sources.note: Lexical/etymological and reader-book notes; a full-text search for stress/accent terms, none.

sources.citation: Heeringa, W. 2005. 'Dialect variation in and around Frisia; classification and relationships'. Us Wurk 54: 125-167.
sources.note: Dialectometric classification (Terschelling varieties included); nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Veen, Ydwine van der. 1988. 'Aasters, een bedreigde Friese taalvariëteit op Terschelling'. Us Wurk 37: 1-46.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey of Aasters (1986 questionnaire); refers to Knop 1954 for the linguistic description; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Smit, J. 1971. 'Skylge en syn tael'. Us Wurk 20: 19-26.
sources.note: Essay on the island's three dialects and their documentation (Knop for Westers, Roggen for Aasters); a few vowel remarks on Meslânzers; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Hoekema, T.B. 1968. 'It Skylger wurd sjudden bern'. Us Wurk 17.
sources.note: Etymological note; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Buma, W.J. 1955. Review of G. Knop, De Spraakkunst der Terschellinger Dialecten (Taalkundige Bijdragen van Noord en Zuid VI, Assen: Van Gorcum 1954, XXVI+270 pp.). De Nieuwe Taalgids 48: 107-110.
sources.note: Gives the chapter structure of Knop 1954 (ch. I historical Klankleer; ch. II Midslands pp. 107-121; ch. III phoneemstelsel of Frisian-Terschelling pp. 122-138; ch. IV Baader intensivering pp. 138-144; ch. V morphology/morphonology pp. 145-257; ch. VI comparison with mainland dialects pp. 258-270); quotes Kapteyn's 'afglijdende accentbeweging' of Frisian in general; nothing on Terschelling word-stress placement.

sources.citation: Daan, Jo. 1955. Review of G. Knop, De spraakkunst der Terschellinger dialecten. Levende Talen 1955: 100-101.
sources.note: General appraisal; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Fokkema, K. 1955. Review of G. Knop, De Spraakkunst der Terschellinger Dialecten. Tijdschrift voor Nederlandse Taal- en Letterkunde 73: 317-319.
sources.note: States the grammar covers Klank- en vormleer of West-Terschelling plus an overview of Midslands, praises the phoneme system §§381-440; no mention of stress.

sources.citation: Knop, G. 1939-40. 'De phonologische beschrijving van het Westerschellingsch. II' [consonant phonemes and clusters]. Onze Taaltuin 8: 11-22.
sources.note: Consonant phoneme system, final devoicing, consonant clusters; nothing on word stress.

sources.citation: Siebs, Th. 1901. 'Geschichte der friesischen Sprache'. In Paul, Grundriss der germanischen Philologie I, 2nd ed., pp. 1152-1464 (Terschelling cited as Osttersch./Westtersch. throughout).
sources.note: a full-text search for stress/accent all Betonung/Akzent passages for Terschelling mentions: only historical vowel developments 'unter Dehnung und Akzentwechsel' and enclitic pronoun forms 'unter dem Nebenton'; no synchronic rule for Terschelling word stress.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Terschelling Frisian'; Frisian Wikipedia 'Skylgersk'; Dutch Wikipedia 'Aasters'.
sources.note: No stress statement; bibliographies name Roggen 1976 (Wêdenboek fon et Aasters), Wichen-Schol 1986 (Woddenboek fan et Westers), Jansen & van Oostendorp 2004 (Taal van de Wadden).

sources.citation: Veen, Klaas F. van der. 2001. 'West Frisian dialectology and dialects'. In H.H. Munske (ed.), Handbuch des Friesischen / Handbook of Frisian Studies, 98-116. Tübingen: Niemeyer.

sources.note: The only full grammar of West-Terschelling Frisian (with Midslands overview and Aasters comparisons); ch. III 'phoneemstelsel' pp. 122-138 (§§381-440) and ch. V morphology/morphonology pp. 145-257 are where a stress statement would sit. Author died 1949, so it is public domain in NL since 2020 and a scan request is realistic.
